kind.value: Social media calendar and content platform with an AI assistant, scheduling, approval workflows, interaction management, listening and analytics

hosting.value: Hosted (no self-host option on its pricing page)

pricingModel.value: Flat tiers by number of social accounts, each with a user cap and unlimited calendars; no per-account add-on is published. Nonprofits get a 50% lifetime discount

freeOption.value: No free plan; the free entry point is the trial

trial.note: The pricing page says only "No credit card required"; the 7 days comes from the trial landing page, whose URL still reads 15-day-free-trial.

entryPaid.value: Starter, $65/month on monthly billing, 12 social accounts and 3 users

plans.value: Starter $65/month (12 social accounts, 3 users) and Beyond $332/month (60 accounts, unlimited users) on monthly billing; Enterprise is custom-priced above 61 accounts. All plans include unlimited calendars
plans.note: The toggle opens on yearly, which shows $49 and $249 per month billed annually. Yearly plans are charged upfront and cannot be ended early.

3.note: Starter covers up to 12 social accounts on monthly billing, so 3 fits with no extras.

30.note: Starter caps at 12 accounts and no per-account add-on is published, so 30 means Beyond, which covers 60 accounts for $332 a month.

networks.value: Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Google Business Profile, Pinterest and Snapchat
networks.note: Neither the integrations page nor the pricing page lists X or Bluesky.

api.value: No public API is mentioned on the pricing or integrations pages; the listed workflow integrations are Zapier, Slack and Microsoft Teams

mcp.value: No MCP server is mentioned on the pricing or integrations pages

ai.value: AI assistant chat, post generation, captions, replies and AI analytics on both plans, with monthly AI usage described as limited on Starter and extended on Beyond. Social listening is metered: 2 a month on Starter, 5 on Beyond

teams.value: 3 users on Starter; unlimited on Beyond and Enterprise. Unlimited calendars on all plans, approval workflows and roles included from Starter, with calendar two-factor enforcement and custom branding on Beyond
